Each agent must submit its first N requests within a bounded inter-arrival variance window; scrutineers model expected cadence and flag traffic whose timing wanders outside it. Sybils spun up in bulk share provisioning clocks, producing a smooth, uniform burst the gate rejects as a flat oasis of regularity amid organic jitter. An attacker must rent staggered launch slots and aged warm-up histories per identity, paying orchestration and delay cost for every fake account.
